proposition: Ibn Turka, having just left Herat, was summoned back, imprisoned, stripped of position and property, tortured and then exiled (830/1427).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: MK names the second apology as the main source for the exile period but cites nothing for this sentence
